limitation: Base MWMs come from a single CoMaps planet release; Navi publishes sidecars only. region_to_leaves maps frozen .rkyv bake_ids to CoMaps leaves for migration; country_groups is the primary region UI source.
threshold_justification: Default include threshold is 0.5% of Navi region area: below that, numeric border noise and ocean/fjord slivers dominate, while still catching meaningful county-scale coverage. CoMaps borders are land polygons (no ocean), so any stable land overlap ≥ 0.05% is also kept as a micro_land_overlap proxy for border roads/places (stricter than ignoring those slivers; true OSM road sampling is not required for v1).
